newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Toyota Finance NZ ups CP programe to NZ$350 mln.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Finance NZ ups CP programe to NZ$350 mln.

text.p: Bank of New Zealand on Monday said Toyota Finance New Zealand Ltd was increasing the size of its New Zealand commercial paper programme to NZ$350 million from $200 million.
BNZ said the increase reflected the success of the programme which was established in December, 1995.
Notes issued under the programme were rated A1+ by ratings agency Standard and Poor's.
The programme was arranged by Bank of New Zealand and the dealers were ANZ Banking Group (NZ) Ltd, BNZ, The National Bank of New Zealand Ltd and Westpac Banking Corporation.
